baseline_statement: Gain is measured against uniform constant deployment at the same starting state of charge, both strategies required to end the lap with at least the energy they started with.
greedy_caveat: Greedy deploys whenever it can, empties the store early and spends most of the lap clipping. It ends with less energy than it started, so it cannot be run again either way. The headline gain is measured against uniform deployment, which is repeatable.

provenance.note: Geometry is derived from measured GPS. Speed, deployment, state of charge and clipping are MODEL OUTPUT from a fitted physics simulation, not measured data — public F1 telemetry contains no energy channels.
provenance.fallback_note: This circuit has not yet run in 2026. Geometry only is taken from the session named above; its speed trace is never used, and the physics is 2026-spec throughout.
